serie-5-1: A man in his thirties washing a red car with a big yellow sponge in the driveway in front of a suburban house; a bucket of soapy water stands on the ground next to him; sunny day, soap foam on the car body.
serie-5-2: An outdoor open-air fruit market in a West African town: a woman vendor in a colourful wax-print dress stands behind her wooden stall full of fruit and hands a bag of ripe mangoes to a female customer standing in front of the stall.
serie-5-3: Evening, a child's bedroom: a boy of about ten sits at his desk under a lit desk lamp, writing in an exercise book with a pencil; school books are open on the desk; dark window behind him.
serie-5-4: Winter scene in Canada: a man and a woman wearing warm coats, tuques and gloves clear snow from the driveway in front of their house with snow shovels; snow banks on both sides, snow-covered roof.
serie-6-1: Inside a hair salon: a female hairdresser stands behind a man seated in a salon chair with a cape around his neck and cuts his hair with scissors and a comb; a large mirror in front of them reflects the scene.
serie-6-2: A sunny backyard: a woman hangs wet clothes (shirts, towels) on a clothesline with clothes pegs; a laundry basket full of clothes sits on the grass at her feet.
serie-6-3: A calm lake in summer: a man sits alone at the end of a wooden dock, holding a fishing rod with the line in the water; a tackle box beside him, a forest of pine trees on the far shore.
serie-6-4: A bathroom: a little girl of about six stands in front of the washbasin on a small step stool and brushes her teeth with a toothbrush, looking at herself in the mirror; a cup and toothpaste on the sink.
